initial.chief_complaint: Fever, body aches and cough since yesterday.

presenting_complaint: Fever, body aches and cough since yesterday.
history_freetext:
Since yesterday evening: sudden fever up to 38.9 C, shivering, severe muscle aches, headache, dry cough and sore throat. A co-worker was diagnosed with influenza last week.
Healthy; no chronic disease, no asthma, no immunosuppression; not pregnant-related (male). No regular medication.
No shortness of breath, no chest pain, no confusion, able to drink fluids; has not taken any medication yet.
Did not receive this season's influenza vaccine. Non-smoker. Works in an office.
